cohort: A female neonate delivered by cesarean section at 31 weeks of gestation, weighing 1538 g, presented with dyspnea, retracted respiration, congestive heart failure, and a large dural arteriovenous fistula.
finding: Transumbilical arterial embolization successfully treated a large dural arteriovenous fistula in a low-birth-weight neonate with congestive heart failure, resulting in clinical improvement and normal long-term growth and development.
